hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) OUT=$(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1) || { echo "Type errors (tsc --noEmit):" >&2; echo "$OUT" | head -30 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env'; then echo 'Blocked: direct edits to .env files are not allowed — edit them manually' && exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty') && if echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'pnpm-lock.yaml'; then echo 'Blocked: do not hand-edit pnpm-lock.yaml — change package.json and run pnpm install' && exit 2; fi
